html.content:
Recommended

Boxplotscore: 1.0

Box-and-whisker showing median, IQR, and outliers per group.

Clinical use: Lab value distributions by arm/visit, PK endpoints

  • cat + numeric → distribution by group
  • sufficient n for box stats

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='boxplot of <numeric> grouped by <factor>'

Best for visualizing the distribution of numeric 'Expression

Alternatives

Heatmapscore: 1.0

Color-coded matrix — rows × columns with optional clustering and dendrograms.

Clinical use: AE incidence by SOC × arm, gene expression heatmap

  • 2 cats as row/col + numeric value
  • enough rows for matrix

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='heatmap of <numeric> with <factor1> rows and <factor2> columns'

Lollipopscore: 1.0

Point-on-stem variant of bar chart — cleaner for many categories.

Clinical use: Gene/protein expression ranked list

  • cat + numeric → lollipop
  • many categories — lollipop cleaner than bar

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='lollipop chart of <numeric> by <factor>'

Volcanoscore: 0.9

Scatter of -log10(p-value) vs log2(fold change) for differential analysis.

Clinical use: DEG analysis, biomarker discovery

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='volcano plot with log2FoldChange on x-axis and -log10 pvalue on y-axis'

Dotplotscore: 0.85

Individual data points per group — best when n < ~50 per group.

Clinical use: Individual lab values, small Phase I cohorts

  • cat + numeric
  • small n — show every point

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='dot plot of <numeric> by <factor>'
